source.name: PB2002 plate boundary model (Bird, 2003), via fraxen/tectonicplates
source.citation: Bird, P. (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, G-cubed 4(3), 1027, doi:10.1029/2001GC000252
source.processing: Consecutive PB2002 steps with the same boundary and class merged; Douglas-Peucker 0.02 deg; rounded to 0.01 deg. 'v' = mean relative plate velocity of the merged steps, mm/yr, from PB2002.
